reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 7 points better, in a game of about 240 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Bulls (confidence).
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 75 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 213 and 262 total points.

analyst.text: Chicago's mood is poor: Tiago Splitter pulled Josh Giddey and Matas Buzelis early in the second half on Friday, criticised their body language, and both looked upset. The Bulls have won one of six at home, Norman Powell is questionable with a hamstring strain, and they face Cleveland on a back-to-back Monday. Denver have won four of five and former Bull DeMar DeRozan returns. The angle leans towards Denver.
